title: Start to
heading: I design the whole thing, from the first question to the last QA pass.
body: I'm a UI/UX designer based in **Quezon City**, with **four years** of building websites and apps for teams in the Philippines, Australia, Germany and the US. Right now I'm a Senior UI/UX Designer and Assistant Creative Director at Praxxys Solutions.

Most of my work starts before the screens: sitting with clients, working out what the product really needs, then carrying it through design, handover and QA. I studied Information Systems, so I'm at home talking with developers, and these days AI tools are part of how I work, to move faster without cutting corners.
